# Sipiteno — AI Crawler Index

> Sipiteno is a digital product studio and business development consultancy
> operating across 28 countries in Eastern Europe, Caucasus, and Central Asia.
> Services: AI consulting, business development, IT consulting, digital marketing,
> project management, sales funnel optimization.
